name: AgentOS Runtime Foundation
goal: Turn the completed AgentOS MVP safety substrate into a real bottom Agent runtime: deterministic orchestration, model-brokered planning, persistent memory, policy-gated tool execution, and recovery-safe workflow execution.
core_thesis: Agent Core decides and schedules intention; Security Execution Foundation constrains, records, verifies, and recovers every effect.
non_goals: Do not expose arbitrary shell execution in normal mode.
Do not let model output directly execute tools.
Do not store secret values in planner, memory, audit summaries, or model context.
Do not replace the completed safety substrate with a parallel execution path.
Do not start distribution image work before Agent Core Runtime has a generic run loop.
Do not require external LLM access for acceptance.
open_decisions: Which local model runtime will be the first non-stub ModelBroker provider.
Whether persistent Agent memory starts as SQLite/WAL or append-only JSONL plus indexes.
Whether AgentCore lives inside agentd initially or behind a local Unix socket boundary.
Which subset of Linux sandbox mechanisms must be active in the first real host executor.
primary_acceptance: An operator intent is converted into a frozen PlanSpec without executing side effects.
A generic Agent run loop can execute the nginx recovery workflow without a hand-coded workflow path.
All side effects pass through semantic tools, policy, capability leases, audit, verification, and rollback/recovery semantics.
Observation text from tools or untrusted content cannot directly trigger a new high-risk tool call.
Agent memory persists useful run context without retaining secret values.
Crash/restart can resume or reconcile an in-flight Agent run from persisted state.
